thread:
Leah (CS): Quick capture from HelixMed onboarding. They surfaced multiple asks affecting finance and go-live. Renewal in ~3w so flagging for triage.

Leah (CS): Items: 1) monthly CSV export of per-route token usage + $cost for finance reporting. 2) per-route embedding TTL override (shorter for dev). 3) console warn at 75/80% reserved capacity. 4) ability to attach billing tags to routes for rollups. 5) soft pause when a route exceeds a soft-cap to prevent surprise billing. Also: onboarding modal doesn't show KMS/service-account verification step and customers stall.

Tom (PM): Impact notes: CSV = high (finance needs for renewal). KMS step = high (blocks go-live). Soft pause & caps = medium-high (billing risk). TTL & tags = medium.

Ibrahim (Eng): Feasibility quick: CSV = small-medium (usage aggregator + CSV endpoint). TTL override = small. Capacity warning = small. Billing tags = small. Soft pause = medium (policy + enforce). KMS onboarding fix = small (modal + backend verify + docs), security review needed.

Tom (PM): Proposed triage: P0 = CSV export + KMS onboarding modal + docs; P1 = soft pause + capacity warnings; P2 = TTL override + billing tags. Agree?

Rae (SE): Short-term workaround for CSV: use usage API and jq to produce CSV. Snippet:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?account=helixmed&group_by=route&start=2026-05-01&end=2026-05-31" \
  | jq -r '.routes[] | [.route, .tokens, .cost] | @csv' > helixmed-may-routes.csv
```

June (Enablement): I can run a 45m onboarding assist tomorrow 11am PT to walk them through KMS steps and share the CSV workaround. Can product add checklist copy to the onboarding modal as an interim fix?

Ibrahim (Eng): I'll take a 2d spike for CSV + KMS verify next week and post findings here.

Leah (CS): Customer update plan: enablement session + manual CSV + we will prioritize KMS modal spike. HelixMed seemed relieved and will wait for the follow-up before finalizing renewal.

triage-bot: please create ticket "onboarding: KMS verify + CSV export" and tag @product @eng within 24h.
